articles.title: Yo Yo Honey Singh Summoned Before Maharashtra Cyber Cell Today In Case About 'Objectionable' Remarks, Plea Seeking Later Date Rejected
articles.description: A complaint has been filed against Honey Singh in connection with allegedly objectionable comments he made at a concert in Delhi. A video clip of his remarks was shared widely on social media, and drew criticism from several users.

articles.title: Telangana hikes foreign liquor prices
articles.description: The Telangana government has increased the maximum retail prices (MRPs) of foreign liquor by up to 6 per cent. Depending on the brand, the price of a full-size bottle has reportedly increased by INR 30 to INR 100. The revision affects 352 foreign liquor brands, including imported Scotch whiskies, single malts, vodkas, gins and wines. The Telangana State Beverages Corporation Limited (TGBCL) issued a circular directing registered foreign liquor suppliers and depot officials to implement the revised prices following the government’s approval of changes to assessable values. The government approved the revision after examining recommendations submitted by the tender committee. Under the revised instructions, suppliers must affix stickers displaying the updated MRPs on stocks held at depots and ensure that consignments are dispatched at the revised rates. Depot managers have also been directed to generate updated price lists, verify them against the list issued by the corporation’s head office and communicate the revised prices to liquor licence holders.

articles.title: Yo Yo Honey Singh summoned by Maha Cyber Cell over objectionable remarks
articles.description: The Maharashtra Cyber Cell has summoned rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh over objectionable remarks made at a concert. Rejecting his plea for a delay, they warned a Look Out Circular might be issued if he fails to appear for the fourth time.

articles.title: Anbumani slams TVK govt over reversal of Chennai electric bus tender cancellation
articles.description: Anbumani questioned how the tender cancellation could have been issued without the government’s knowledge. He demanded accountability from those making the policy decisions.

articles.title: Hyderabad defence firm gets Rs 56.8Cr BDL single tender
articles.description: Hyderabad: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), a Hyderabad-based defence Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), issued an ‘urgent’ single tender to a private company, Indian Express has reported. articles.title: Women own 38 pc of registered MSMEs with 3.69 crore enterprises, labour force participation surge
articles.description: New Delhi, Oct 15 (IANS) About 3.69 crore registered MSMEs were women‑owned, representing about 38 per cent of all registrations, an official factsheet said on Thursday. The women's labour force participation rate (LFPR) for those aged 15 and above rose from 23.3 per cent in 2017‑18 to 40 per cent in 2025. Over 1.07 lakh recognised startups had at least one woman director or partner and these accounted for approximately 48 per cent of all recognised startups. In absolute terms, an estimated 20 crore women aged 15 years and above were employed in India during 2025. Custom Ad: Multiplex “This broader transition is being supported through policies that expand women’s access to safer workplaces, social protection, entrepreneurship, formalisation and financial opportunities,” the statement noted. Worker Population Ratio (WPR) increased from 22 per cent for women in 2017-18 to 38.8 per cent in 2025. In absolute terms, an estimated 20 crore women aged 15 years and above were employed in India during 2025. Women constitute nearly 70 per cent of the direct workforce in mobile phone manufacturing as of July 2026. Across the wider electronics manufacturing sector, women account for nearly 30 per cent of the workforce created over the last decade. “Formal recognition, finance and market access provide key areas for strengthening women-led enterprises,” the statement noted. Swavalamban Scheme supports young women from business ideation to enterprise creation through entrepreneurship training, finance and market guidance, and legal support. Selected participants also receive 21 weeks of mentorship and handholding to help develop sustainable enterprises. The Yashasvini Campaign promoted greater participation of women in entrepreneurship by achieving gender parity on the Udyam Registration Portal and Udyam Assist Platform by 2029. The Yashasvini Campaign had facilitated over 22 lakh women-owned MSME registrations as of July 2026. Further, total procurement from women-owned MSEs was 3.8 per cent in FY26, exceeding the 3 per cent public procurement target. —IANS aar/ag

articles.title: 783 Cooperatives Register as Buyers on GeM Portal
articles.description: A total of 783 cooperative societies have registered as buyers on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal, gaining access to goods and services offered by approximately 10.25 lakh vendors. The initiative aims to promote transparent, affordable and efficient procurement in the cooperative sector, enabling societies to source products and services through a digital marketplace.
